providers.title: Models by generators
providers.scope: A model of a coherator is a globular set with a choice of each generating operation subject only to its two face equations; morphisms are the globular maps preserving the generating operations.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Limits, colimits and free models
providers.scope: The models form a complete and cocomplete category with limits and filtered colimits computed on cells and a free model functor; free models on pasting schemes are representable, and free models on finite globular sets are finitely presentable.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The small object argument
providers.scope: For a set of morphisms with finitely presentable domains, every morphism factors as a countable cellular extension followed by a morphism with the right lifting property.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Division
providers.scope: Multiplication by a fixed cell at any level below the top induces bijections between homotopy sets with prescribed boundaries.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The exact-boundary test
providers.scope: A morphism of models is a weak equivalence exactly when every cell of the target with a boundary coming from the domain is homotopic to the image of a cell with exactly that boundary.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Lifting tests
providers.scope: The morphisms with the right lifting property against all boundary inclusions are exactly the weak equivalences with the right lifting property against all source inclusions.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The cutoff reflector
providers.scope: The models with unique fillers above dimension q form a reflective subcategory, and the reflection keeps all cells through dimension q.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free shapes
providers.scope: Free models on pasting schemes, and their coskeletal reflections, are contractible.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Upper splitting
providers.scope: Under the descending induction hypothesis, an upper cellular weak equivalence with cellular source has a retraction, and its pushouts along maps to cellular models are weak equivalences.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Trees are contractible
providers.scope: Free models on tree diagrams at depth n are contractible, using only expansions of index n + 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Whiskered shapes
providers.scope: Free models on pasting schemes with a whisker attached to every n-cell are contractible.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The partial path object
providers.scope: A functorial partial path object whose two endpoints lift all boundary inclusions and whose joint endpoint map lifts the source inclusion in dimension n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Henry's pushout conjecture
providers.scope: For every coherator, every elementary expansion of a cellular model, along an arbitrary cell, is a weak equivalence.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The canonical semi-model structure
providers.scope: The models carry a cofibrantly generated left semi-model structure with boundary inclusions as generating cofibrations, source inclusions as generating trivial cofibrations, and every object fibrant.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The homotopy hypothesis (assuming Henry's comparison theorem)
providers.scope: The semi-model category of models of any coherator is Quillen equivalent to topological spaces.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
